title: Acceleration for Affine-coupling problems
summary: Saddle-point problems play an important role in modern machine learning, including robust optimization and algorithmic fairness. We investigate structured convex--concave minimax problems where the primal variable lies in a high-dimensional, unconstrained space $\mathbb{R}^d$, while the dual variable is confined to a constrained, low-dimensional space $\mathbb{R}^J$, with $J\ll d$.
